title: Orphan-sweep kill switch bypassable via the library surface

claim_adjudication.claim: applySweep does not honor the documented kill switch when called directly with opts.enabled === undefined
claim_adjudication.counterevidenceSought: any in-repo caller that imports applySweep directly
claim_adjudication.alternativeExplanation: kill switch is CLI-only by design
claim_adjudication.downgradeTrigger: if a maintainer adds a docstring on applySweep that mandates forwarding opts.enabled = isSweepEnabled(process.env)

title: Plan-time parent-pid gate leaves freshly-orphaned daemons alive

claim_adjudication.claim: a daemon whose parent dies between planSweep and applySweep is not reaped, even though the launcher self-heals
claim_adjudication.alternativeExplanation: design intent requires a SECOND apply pass after a grace window
claim_adjudication.downgradeTrigger: if design intent is explicitly documented as 'next session's process-sweep catches the orphan'
